title: Unify flag serialization codec and expunge versioned-admin query endpoints
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Over the past three years we accumulated multiple on-the-wire encodings and translation shims for feature flags and rollout metadata (query-param versioning, admin v0 endpoints, dual-write transports). These cause increased allocation in the gateway, complex merge logic in the control plane, and frequent incidents where older clients receive incompatible configs. This ticket unifies the flag serialization codec used in control-plane manifests, removes the legacy versioned admin query endpoints, and provides a migration shim + telemetry to validate client upgrades. The goal is: smaller payloads, single canonical parser in the runtime, and removal of the query-param/versioned admin surface used by internal tooling.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical flag serialization codec (protobuf v2 schema + compact field ordering) is implemented in the control plane and runtime and documented in the design doc.
Legacy admin endpoints that accept ?v=0 and /admin/v0/* query routes are removed from the API gateway and return 410 with guidance header for 30 days behind a feature flag then 404.
A migration shim running in the control plane translates incoming v0 payloads to canonical format for 4 weeks with debug telemetry to identify remaining clients.
End-to-end benchmarks show at least 18% reduction in median admin request CPU time and 12% reduction in serialized payload size for typical rollout manifests.
No production traffic regression in canary region after rollout (error rate <= baseline + 0.2%).
tasks: Design doc: propose canonical codec and field ordering, backward-compat rules and schema evolution guide (owner: Maya)
Implement canonical serializer/deserializer in control plane (owner: Luis)
Add runtime parser based on consolidated codec and remove duplicate parsers (owner: Runtime team)
Build migration shim: accept v0/v1, translate to canonical and emit telemetry (owner: Luis)
E2E bench and payload-size comparison (owner: SRE)
API gateway rule change: deprecate v0 endpoints behind flag, return 410 with X-Deprecation-Info header (owner: Infra)
Canary rollout: enable shim in staging, then canary region, monitor telemetry and error budgets (owner: Release)
Remove shim and permanently expunge v0 routes after 30 days and zero clients identified (owner: Release)
Update Console docs and engineer runbook for troubleshooting (owner: DevEx)
notes: Design trade-offs: Protocol buffers selected for compactness and forward/backward compatibility; alternative considered was CBOR but lacked strong schema tooling in our stack.
We intentionally keep field tags stable; any future additions must be additive and avoid renumbering to keep rollout safe.
Telemetry: add metric flag_translation.errors and gauge flag_translation.active_old_clients tagged by sdk_version.
Fallback policy: if translation fails for a client, emit a tombstone config that forces safe defaults rather than crash consumers.
Coordination: we must align with customer success before gateway 410 enforcement for any enterprise instances using private deployments.
